claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord.attunementEligibility
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing record can represent only a boolean attunement requirement, not who is eligible to attune. This item's spellcasting, recharge, and destruction fit cleanly, but the attunement gate is still lost.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Wand, Rare (Requires Attunement by a Spellcaster)
